scope: Corollary 4.7 (Primitive evaluation and positive twisting) of the manuscript “The two-primary Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formula in Selmer corank at most one” (preprints/The-two-primary-Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer-formula-in-Selmer-corank-at-most-one-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 002 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 734e4050dc8416c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the square construction with A = 1, one may use an integral combination of symbols with δ(a) = 1 and common smoothing integers. If a fixed positive fundamental quadratic character χh, prime to 2N, is included in the field weight, the integral coefficient identification with the twist E′ h transports (K4) to the corresponding twist-period formula, with its actual smoothing factors and omissions.
